name: rooms-api
description: Owns the fixed room catalog (seeded at deploy, read-only through this API) and every member's bookings. Lists rooms free for a requested date/time range and capacity, creates a booking after checking for an overlapping booking on the same room and for the group exceeding the room's capacity, lists the caller's own bookings, and cancels a booking only when the caller made it. Does not add, edit or remove rooms, does not handle recurring bookings, and does not send notifications.
